dz: 在新法兰西省蒙特利尔，一名法语名字为玛丽-约瑟夫·安吉利克的奴隶因放火烧毁了该市大部分地区而被处死。
de: In Montreal, New France, a  slave known by the French name of Marie-Joseph Angélique is put to death, having been convicted of setting the fire that destroyed much of the city.
